### Ghan Cinematic — AI Film Studio

End-to-end cinematic pipeline: script → 10s shot breakdown → identity-locked keyframes → video, routed across 10 providers — local Qwen/ComfyUI or cloud (Grok, Gemini, OpenAI, Replicate) — with per-shot retries.

URL: https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/ai/ghan-cinematic

### H3 Director Studio — Local AI Film Timeline

A local director's desk for MiniMax H3 video, with ComfyUI kept headless as the engine. Shots live on a timeline rather than in a node graph: Qwen Image 2.1 makes text-to-image and image-to-image stills, then H3 animates them as text-to-video, first frame, first + last frame, or references + voice. One source portrait is locked across stills and video for consistent identity. “Continue from previous shot's final frame” writes the exact previous final frame as frame 0, attaches a tail clip of the previous shot as a motion reference, and morphs into generated footage with motion-compensated interpolation — no jump, no freeze and no doubled silhouette. Every render is kept as a take with its seed, prompt, graph and log; accepted takes export as one MP4. The code is open source under MIT.

URL: https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/ai/h3-director-studio

3D space combat with tactical boss interception — hangar loadouts, laser / plasma / spread, shields and hull, bombs and overdrive, and bosses that arrive with their own health bar.

### Aether Architect

Third-person adventure for Android in Unreal Engine 5.8 — floating islands, crystal pickups and a gate that stays shut until the count is met. Motion-matching locomotion, StateTree behaviour.

URL: https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/aether-architect

### Harmony Heart Pro (NVC Edition)

An AI-powered Non-Violent Communication coach for couples. Gemini-driven, in five languages, on Android via Capacitor, with Supabase underneath.

URL: https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/harmony-heart-pro

### Recipe Roulette

Five dropdowns — mood, energy, cuisine, diet, time cap — and one gold SPIN. It returns a full recipe card: timings, servings, cost per serving and a video tutorial already matched to the dish.

URL: https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/recipe-roulette

### Podcast Discovery Wheel

Pick a category, spin a gold dial, get one episode instead of a feed — with an AI summary, similar discoveries and a Gemini-powered chat for what to listen to next.

URL: https://massimojj.github.io/mg-ghanbari/apps/podcast-discovery-wheel

### Orbit Defender

A top-down space shooter for Android — scatter, laser and plasma weapons, bombs, shields and a boss that announces itself. React + Canvas 2D, packaged with Capacitor.
